statement: Phase 4B-1 harness complete; external LLM benchmark blocked by unavailable API credits; no LLM model promoted.
why_attempted: Phase 4A showed the deterministic baseline and a MiniLM + Logistic Regression classifier both fall far short of usable Spanish/Portuguese incident understanding on frozen Challenge Set v2, so Phase 4B-1 evaluated whether a stronger pretrained language-understanding component could clear a pre-registered bar.

model_identifiers.note: Both identifiers are present in the credential's model catalog. Neither was rejected, renamed or substituted.

results.note: No field above is populated because no benchmark response was accepted. Absence of a result is not a result.

quality_gate.note: The gate is pre-registered and unobserved for both models. Neither Luna nor Terra passed it, and neither failed it.

interpretation_rules: A billing or quota failure is an infrastructure condition, not a model-quality failure, and is never counted as one.
A blocked benchmark never lowers a model's score and never raises it.
No placeholder, estimated, simulated or illustrative model metric exists in this repository.
The Phase 4A failure of the other candidates is not evidence about Luna or Terra.

authoritative_evidence.note: Phase 4A remains the authoritative recorded evidence. No LLM result supersedes or weakens it.

frozen_artifacts_unmodified.note: The prompt, schema, quality gate, model identifiers and Challenge Set v2 are unchanged by this closure, so the benchmark remains reproducible exactly as frozen.

reproduction.blocked_on: an OpenAI account with available API credits
steps: Set OPENAI_API_KEY in the shell environment
reproduction.on_reproduction: The gate is evaluated on first observation and stays unchanged afterwards, preserving its pre-registration.

secrets.note: Authentication succeeded, so no credential value or request identifier is recorded in this artifact.
